protocol.source_graph: actual CUDA Graph kernel/memcpy/memset nodes; independent Q/K/V and gate/up branches retained
protocol.source_modification: only add dependencies to a clone; preserve all original nodes and dependencies
protocol.common_preparation: identical source capture and standalone-node profiling available to all methods; measured cost reported separately; no uncounted end-to-end feedback for decisions
protocol.confirmation: random interleaving, 32 rounds; source graph, A/A, serial baseline and selected graphs; confirmation measurements excluded from learning
protocol.action_to_edge: predecessor at requested level minus one, excluding target and all descendants; uniform choice

unspecified_paper_details_fixed_here.aggregation: incoming directed edges with self loops and symmetric degree normalization

protocol.matched_budget_extension: random uses uniform valid actions; DQN uses learned Q values; ComposeDES scores the same action-generated graphs and updates shared parameter weights. Target DQN weights stay frozen, epsilon 0.05; ComposeDES updates with the same target query budget. Zero-target-feedback selection reported separately.
protocol.reproduction_boundary: published algorithmic mechanisms and hyperparameters reproduced on a different application; not an exact reproduction of unpublished implementation choices or SSTA results
